name: flux-monorepo
description: Flux 无界工作流 — Windows 桌面端 + SaaS 云端 monorepo

scripts.build:apps: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @flux/api build && pnpm --filter @flux/desktop build
scripts.test:ci: pnpm test:architecture && pnpm --filter @flux/workflow-runtime test:unit && pnpm --filter @flux/api test:core && pnpm --filter @flux/desktop test:unit && pnpm --filter @flux/desktop build && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:integrity: pnpm test:architecture && pnpm run build:apps && pnpm --filter @flux/workflow-runtime test:unit && pnpm --filter @flux/api test:dto && node packages/node-sdk/dist/custom-node-rules.smoke.js && node packages/node-sdk/dist/builtin/expression.smoke.js && node packages/node-sdk/dist/builtin/expanded-nodes.smoke.js && node apps/api/dist/modules/auth/auth-runtime-config.smoke.js && node apps/api/dist/modules/auth/auth.smoke.js && node apps/api/dist/modules/executions/execution-queue.smoke.js && node apps/api/dist/modules/executions/execution-resume.smoke.js && node apps/api/dist/modules/executions/node-scenarios.smoke.js && node apps/api/dist/database/database.smoke.js && node apps/api/dist/modules/workflows/workflows.service.smoke.js && node apps/api/dist/modules/executions/executions.service.smoke.js && pnpm --filter @flux/desktop test:unit && node apps/desktop/test/account-management.contract.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/workflow-sharing.contract.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/local-first-workspace.contract.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/view-transition.contract.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/workspace-service-provider.contract.mjs && node apps/desktop/test/custom-node-studio.contract.mjs && pnpm exec playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/conflict-contract.spec.ts e2e/local-new-workflow.spec.ts e2e/view-switch-continuity.spec.ts
